pattern: は別として（はべつとして）
purpose: Set one issue aside to consider another.
keywords: Noun + は別として; clause + かどうかは別として
Leaving the price aside, I liked the shape.
Whether it succeeds or not aside, I want to try.
Joking aside, tell me your actual plans.
formation: Noun + は別として; clause + かどうかは別として
restrictions: The set-aside issue is not necessarily unimportant or permanently dismissed.
mistake: It does not deny the first issue; it temporarily separates it from the discussion.
